title: Radio Nacional de Angola, Radio Mocambique
notes: Portuguese off 3265, 3375, 4862, 11955 kHz, 1979-1988. Luanda signing on at 0400, its interval signal and anthem, then Maputo: the Mocambique interval signal, an identification given in English at 0357 UTC, and the Emissora do Sofala in 1988.
